prerequisites: Turkish language proficiency — instruction is delivered in Turkish
No prior project idea or formed team is required to apply
duration: Approximately 12 months, in two main phases of 10 training modules each (20 modules total), with four elimination rounds plus mentoring
financial_aid: Selected projects receive funding to implement their initiatives; forty finalist teams receive 'sermayeye erişim, çeşitli ödüller ve melek yatırımcılarla bir araya gelme fırsatı' (access to capital, various awards, and the opportunity to meet angel investors)
selection_process: Register at gencupshift.org or at the nearest Gençlik Merkezi, then progress through four elimination rounds across the two phases; 40 teams reach the final stage.
award_or_output: A developed social-innovation project with training, mentoring and, for the 40 finalist teams, access to capital, awards and angel investors
leadership_evidence: STRONG, AND IT BUILDS THE EVIDENCE RATHER THAN REQUIRING IT — which makes it the mirror image of Three Dot Dash and Ashoka. Those two demand an existing initiative; Genç UPSHIFT explicitly does not ('No prior project development or team formation is required'), so it is the right recommendation for a 15-17 year old whose gap IS leadership rather than one who has already closed it. A participant works in a team through 20 modules and four competitive elimination rounds over roughly a year to build a social-innovation project; finalists receive capital. A student can demonstrate: co-founded a social-innovation project inside a national programme run by a government ministry with UNICEF; survived four selection rounds; and, if a finalist, secured funding. That combination of accessible entry, real duration, competitive filtering and a funded outcome is the single most useful shape for the exact catalogue gap this lane exists to close — and it is Turkish, free, and reaches all 81 provinces.

selection_process: Open registration — in person at the nearest youth centre, or online through e-Devlet. No selection.
award_or_output: Membership giving access to volunteer clubs (gönüllülük kulüpleri) alongside social-cultural, science-technology, fine-arts and sports clubs; academies; free courses and workshops; study spaces and libraries; and participation in national and international programmes
leadership_evidence: HONEST DOWNGRADE — THIS IS INFRASTRUCTURE, NOT AN ACHIEVEMENT. Membership itself demonstrates nothing: it is free, open, unselective, and available to every 12-29 year old in Türkiye. Nobody should present 'member of a Gençlik Merkezi' as a credential. What it IS worth recording for is access: it is the entry point to the volunteer clubs, the Vizyon Kulübü, the international programmes, and — critically — to Genç UPSHIFT, which is delivered through these same 162 centres. For a counselor advising a Turkish student whose gap is community impact and who has no obvious route in, this is the free, nationwide, no-barrier first step that unlocks the programmes that DO produce evidence. ORYN's scoring should treat this as an enabling action with near-zero intrinsic profile value, and the advisor copy should say so plainly rather than letting a student count it as an activity.

age_range.quote: more than 300 young people aged between 11 and 18 years, elected as Members of Youth Parliament (MYPs)

prerequisites: Must live, work, be educated or volunteer in the area being contested
program_dates: Current MYP term: April 2026 to March 2027
duration: Two-year terms; elections held every two years
selection_process: Competitive public election. Candidates are nominated through their school, youth group or local council, then campaign among their peers on a manifesto of their own policies; young people vote. Elections run 'in over 70% of constituencies, and often in schools.'
award_or_output: Election as a Member of Youth Parliament; participation in regional roundtables and the UKYP annual sitting where MYPs debate motions and vote on campaign priorities; delivery of the national Make Your Mark ballot
leadership_evidence: THE STRONGEST SHAPE IN THE WHOLE LANE — AN ACTUAL CONTESTED ELECTION. This is the only record I verified where a 14-18 year old wins a named public office by standing on a manifesto and being voted for by their peers across a geographic constituency. There are only 300-odd MYPs for the entire UK, which makes the seat genuinely scarce. An MYP can demonstrate: wrote a manifesto, campaigned, won a constituency election, held a two-year term, debated and voted on national campaign priorities at the annual sitting, and ran engagement sessions in schools and the community. Every element of that is externally verifiable through the local authority that ran the election. This is exactly what ORYN's spec (Phase 6.3) means when it distinguishes a real leadership signal from a student who merely typed 'President'. HONEST CORRECTION OF A COMMON CLAIM: MYPs do NOT sit in the House of Commons as legislators. The NYA page describes their own annual UKYP sitting, not membership of Parliament; a student or aggregator implying otherwise would be overstating it.

city: Strasbourg — inside the European Parliament and around the EYE Village
eligible_countries: European Union and beyond — EYE2025 drew participants representing 160 nationalities

age_range.quote: The EYE is a unique opportunity for 16- to 30-year-olds to inspire and get inspired, to debate directly with Members of the European Parliament

award_or_output: Participation in debates with Members of the European Parliament and other European decision-makers, plus workshops, visits and artistic performances, alongside roughly 9,000 other young people
latest_verified_cycle: EYE2025, the sixth edition, held 13-14 June 2025
leadership_evidence: WEAK — RECORDED HONESTLY AS EXPOSURE, NOT LEADERSHIP. EYE is a large biennial gathering of roughly 9,000 young people for two days of debates and workshops. The European Parliament's own description is about debating and exchanging views, not about holding a role, leading a team, or delivering an outcome. There is no evidence on the official page of competitive selection, and registration in past editions was reported as first-come-first-served with balance criteria applied. A participant can honestly claim attendance at a European Parliament youth event; they cannot claim a leadership position or a selective distinction. A counselor should rank this well below Euroscola (which at least involves winning a national school competition) and far below an elected youth-parliament seat. Its genuine value is civic exposure and the chance to meet MEPs — worth recommending to a student building interest in European affairs, not to a student who needs leadership evidence.

cost.payment_schedule: Pre-payment required by 25 September 2026; final payment due 15 January 2027

selection_process: Schools register as delegations (FORM I by 25 September 2026 with pre-payment; FORM II listing complete participants by 20 November 2026). Individual applications are accepted only from students at participating schools, and only for specialised roles: Student Officer, NATO, Historical Security Council, International Court, Comité Français, ICES and Press.
individual_or_team: school delegation, with individual applications for specialised roles

latest_verified_cycle: 59th Annual Conference, 25-29 January 2027 — registration open, FORM I deadline 25 September 2026
leadership_evidence: TWO-TIER, AND THE TIERS ARE VERY DIFFERENT — a counselor must not conflate them. Tier 1, attending as a delegate in a school delegation: this is participation. The school registers, pays €190 plus €340 per person, and the student debates in committee. There is no selection beyond whatever the school does internally, and it demonstrates preparation and public speaking, not leadership. Tier 2, the specialised roles: THIMUN accepts individual applications for Student Officer, NATO, Historical Security Council, International Court, Comité Français, ICES and Press. A Student Officer chairs a committee at an international conference of roughly 3,200 students from around 200 schools — a named, applied-for, competitively-allocated position of real responsibility. That is a genuine leadership artefact and it is worth a counselor asking specifically which tier a student held, because a CV line reading 'THIMUN' hides the entire distinction. COST WARNING: at €340 per person plus travel and accommodation in The Hague, this is one of the more expensive records in this lane and is not accessible to every student; ORYN should surface the fee prominently rather than recommending it blind.
